username.title: Select a Username
username.subtitle: Choose a unique username for your account. You can not change it later.

username.hint: At least 3 characters, letters and numbers only

errors.short: Username must be at least 3 characters long
errors.taken: Username is already taken by another user

email.title: Enter Your Email
email.subtitle: Your email will be used for notifications, password recovery, and to verify your account at the end of registration.
email.label: Enter your email address

errors.validation: Email must be a valid email address

password.title: Set a Password
password.subtitle: Choose a strong password to protect your account. You can change it later in your account settings.

password.label: Enter a password for your account
password.hint: At least 8 characters, letters and numbers only

errors.length: Password must be at least 8 characters long
errors.uppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter
errors.lowercase: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter
errors.digit: Password must contain at least one digit
errors.special: Password must contain at least one special character (e.g., !@#$%^&*)

preferences.title: Set Your Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Choose your preferences to show you relevant content.

locale.label: Select Preferred Language
locale.hint: Select a language for interface and content

country.label: Select Your Country

birthday.label: Select Your Birthday
birthday.hint: Your birthday helps us provide age-appropriate content
